notes: Official 2026 USMLE cardiovascular outline includes arrhythmias/conduction disorders.
AVNRT StatPearls last updated March 25, 2026; dual AV nodal pathways, slow-fast reentry, short RP and pseudo-R-prime V1 findings directly supported.

duplicate_gate.selection_history: Multiple earlier cardiovascular candidates were rejected for canonical overlap before AVNRT was selected.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Abrupt regular narrow-complex tachycardia with very short RP, pseudo-R-prime in V1 and PAC initiation reconstructs typical slow-fast AVNRT.
adversarial_second_pass.AVRT_attack: Orthodromic AVRT requires an extranodal accessory pathway for the retrograde limb, not a dual AV nodal slow-fast circuit.
adversarial_second_pass.flutter_attack: Typical flutter is macroreentry around the tricuspid annulus/cavotricuspid isthmus.
adversarial_second_pass.atrial_tach_attack: Focal atrial tachycardia does not require the described dual-pathway reentry.
adversarial_second_pass.CPVT_attack: Calcium-triggered delayed afterdepolarizations produce ventricular polymorphic/bidirectional arrhythmia rather than this narrow-complex AV nodal tachycardia.
adversarial_second_pass.cueing_check: ECG clues identify the electrophysiologic syndrome, but the task requires reconstructing the initiating conduction sequence.
